guardrails: public NCBI/GenBank records are acquired only to support minimal per-segment alignment design
all analyses must keep S, M, and L separate rather than pooling segments
this evidence does not by itself justify host-switch, spillover, reassortment, or transmission claims
host labels remain submitter-provided and should be taxonomy-audited before any host-associated interpretation
remaining_limitations: all four selected isolates come from a single host species and a narrow geographic context, so host-switch design is still unsupported
this gate supports alignment readiness only; inference would still require a prespecified phylogenetic model and metadata audit
the sampled candidate universe was limited to recent NCBI search results and should be refreshed if broader diversity becomes necessary
